name: Yotsuba no Clover ~Akane Sasu Tsukiyo ni Yakata Terasarete~
original_name: 四つ葉のクローバー～茜指す月夜に館照らされて～
source: The protagonist, Kinoshita Kouichi, works for an insurance company and is sent to investigate the death of a famous painter. He goes to the painter's house and meets his four beautiful daughters. Can he solve the mystery without being killed himself?
translation: The protagonist, Kinoshita Kouichi, works for an insurance company and is sent to investigate the death of a famous painter. He goes to the painter's house and meets his four beautiful daughters. Can he solve the mystery without being killed himself?
